component.name: Auto USB/IP-QT
component.summary: Automatic USB-over-IP device manager, gamepad tester, and diagnostics hub

description.p: Auto USB/IP-QT is an encrypted, zero-configuration USB-over-IP client and server management system for Linux and Windows. It provides passwordless Polkit privilege escalation, AppArmor confinement, automatic mDNS server discovery, sleep/wake reconnection handling, and real-time gamepad diagnostic tools.

ul.li: Passwordless Polkit authorization for vhci-hcd and usbip binding
TLS 1.3 encrypted control channel with optional certificate pinning
Real-time Web Dashboard with server telemetry and remote journal streaming
Multi-user lockout and in-use device detection
Interactive Gamepad Evaluation Hub supporting Sony DualSense triggers/motion and Kenney SVG prompts
Adaptive system theme engine with live OS prefers-color-scheme detection

screenshot.caption: Main Dashboard and Device Management Interface
Interactive Gamepad Diagnostics and Telemetry Visualizer
Diagnostics Console and Live Event Stream

description.p: Release 2.3.0: UI de-slopping, full server control persistence, heartbeat device sync improvements, clean CLI help commands, and cross-platform stability fixes.

Added adaptive theme engine with live OS prefers-color-scheme detection, cross-platform desktop toast notifications (Windows Action Center and Linux D-Bus), About modal dialog, and standalone release build pipeline.
Major 2.0 release featuring multi-user lockout detection, subnet scanning, WiX MSI installer, and embedded Inter/JetBrains typography.
